items.title: Show HN: Omnara – Open-Source Alternative to Claude Managed Agents
items.titleZh: Show HN：Omnara – Claude 托管代理的开源替代方案
items.summary:
Hey all, Kartik from Omnara ( https://omnara.com ) here. We're building an open-source API for running durable agents. You create an agent with an API call, and Omnara runs the agent loop, gives the agent sandboxes to run commands in, and handles secrets, permissions, and RBAC. Each agent's state is stored in Postgres, so agents survive restarts and cost nothing while idle. You can message them and stream their events over the API. You may remember us from our early days, when we made a remote-control phone app for Claude Code and Codex. Since the harness ran on a laptop back then, we had to build a relay to reach it, it stopped when the laptop closed, and moving it to a cloud sandbox meant syncing code and agent state between machines. We didn't think remote-controlling a local agent was end-game for how people would run agents, so we built a new product where the agent runs in the cloud, any client can talk to it through an API, and it can still use your laptop as one of its machines. Anthropic and OpenAI are building hosted versions of this, like Claude Managed Agents and the OpenAI Agents API. Omnara is an open-source version you can run on your own servers and use your own models. It's basically a harness server like the opencode or codex servers, but durable, scalable, with the usual harness features like file and shell tools, subagents, compaction, permission prompts, MCP, skills, memory, yada yada yada. Here's some interesting architectural decisions we made while building this out: Most harnesses, like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Goose, etc, run the agent loop in one long-lived process that keeps its log in a JSONL or SQLite file. In Omnara, the log is an append-only event log in Postgres, with inputs, model outputs and tool calls stored as typed rows in their own tables. The loop runs on stateless workers in the control plane. A worker runs one iteration of the loop, either a model call or the tool calls it produced, then releases the agent and puts the next iteration on a queue in Postgres. Whichever worker is free picks it up, so each iteration of an agent's loop can run in a different process on a different machine. Each iteration's result commits in one transaction, so the model output, its tool calls, usage and the next wakeup are saved together or not at all. If a worker dies mid-iteration, nothing commits, its lease expires, and another worker retries it. Agents waiting on a user, a tool or a retry don't hold a worker, so one worker can multiplex thousands of agents. Also unlike other harnesses, the machines that the workers (our agent loop) run on aren't where the agent runs its commands. Instead, any macOS or Linux machine with an internet connection, like your laptop or any cloud sandbox, can run a small daemon (omnarad) that connects out to Omnara, so it doesn't need any open inbound ports. The agent then gets tools for that machine, like running a command or editing a file. An agent can have any number of machines connected to it. A fun thing I like to do is I have my laptop and a cloud sandbox connected to the same agent, so when my laptop is on, my agent codes there and I can interact with it, and I have it often push to Github. When I close my laptop, my agent sees the laptop went offline, pulls the latest changes to its cloud sandbox, and continues there. The entire codebase is open source at https://github.com/omnara-ai/omnara , and it’s self hostable, even on a single machine with docker compose. You can also use the hosted version at https://omnara.com . Let me know what you think!

items.title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
items.titleZh: Navalia：通过可验证的任务综合和长期培训后推进协同工作代理
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26887v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceable evidence and actual data dependencies between steps. We further use independent LLM review and programmatic checks to verify evidence consistency and answer correctness. The verified tasks are then used for trajectory collection, cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) to improve long-horizon task execution. Navalia, initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, achieves consistent gains over the base model across all five benchmarks: OfficeQA Pro, FinSearchComp, Finance Agent Benchmark, APEX-Agents-AA, and Workspace-Bench-Lite. These results demonstrate that Navalia improves evidence integration, tool use, and long-horizon task execution capabilities and generalizes to broader Cowork settings, including general office tasks.

items.title: Large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction and progress updates
items.titleZh: 基于大语言模型和强化学习的自主构建和进度更新
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26899v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Due to the rapid growth of the global population, traditional construction methods are gradually unable to meet the current housing demand. The advancement of machine learning algorithms has encouraged researchers to explore their applications in the construction industry, leading to more intelligent and efficient building processes. In particular, the rise of large language models in recent years has provided more possibilities for the transformation from traditional construction to smart construction. In this study, a large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction method is proposed. An enhanced soft actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm is developed to plan actions for a mobile crane according to construction tasks. Robot kinematics and control algorithms are used to ensure that the actions generated by the reinforcement learning algorithm can be executed by the crane. In addition, a customized embedding model is developed to extract information from the construction environment according to user interests. Then, a large language model, ChatGPT 5, is used to update construction progress, provide safety information to control system, and generate construction progress reports. The feasibility of proposed method is verified through several full-scall retaining wall construction experiments.

Abstract: Recent studies have proposed reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods that enable LLMs to generate high-quality RTL circuits from natural-language specifications. Existing approaches optimize circuit PPA (Power, Performance, Area) by aggregating multiple objectives into a single scalar reward, making it difficult to simultaneously generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions across different trade-offs such as low power, low latency, and small area. However, in practical design, the relative importance of each objective varies depending on product requirements and design constraints; thus, obtaining a diverse and high-quality candidate set is beneficial in that designers can choose a preferred trade-off a posteriori. In this work, we are the first to propose a learning method for LLM-based circuit generation that optimizes, not the quality of a single circuit, but the quality and diversity of the entire circuit set obtained through multiple generations in the PPA objective space. The proposed method consists of (1) a generation-based training pipeline that reformulates coverage improvement of the entire Pareto solution set into a sequential circuit generation problem, and (2) a reward function based on Hypervolume Contribution (HVC) that measures how much a generated circuit contributes to the Pareto front. Evaluation on the RTLLM v2 benchmark shows that the proposed method achieves +13.3 percentage points in relative Hypervolume over a baseline without PPA optimization and +14.4 percentage points over a single-objective reinforcement learning method, while also demonstrating superiority in circuit diversity.

arXiv:2610.26904v1 公告类型：新
摘要：最近的研究提出了具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法，使法学硕士能够从自然语言规范生成高质量的 RTL 电路。现有方法通过将多个目标聚合为单个标量奖励来优化电路 PPA（功耗、性能、面积），这使得很难在不同的权衡（例如低功耗、低延迟和小面积）上同时生成多种帕累托最优解决方案。然而，在实际设计中，每个目标的相对重要性根据产品要求和设计约束而变化；因此，获得多样化且高质量的候选集是有益的，因为设计者可以事后选择首选的权衡。在这项工作中，我们第一个提出了一种基于 LLM 的电路生成的学习方法，该方法优化的不是单个电路的质量，而是通过 PPA 目标空间中的多代获得的整个电路集的质量和多样性。所提出的方法包括（1）基于生成的训练管道，它将整个 Pareto 解决方案集的覆盖率改进重新表述为顺序电路生成问题，以及（2）基于超体积贡献（HVC）的奖励函数，用于测量生成的电路对 Pareto 前沿的贡献程度。对 RTLLM v2 基准的评估表明，与没有 PPA 优化的基线相比，所提出的方法在相对超体积方面实现了 +13.3 个百分点，比单目标强化学习方法实现了 +14.4 个百分点，同时还展示了电路多样性的优越性。

items.title: MedPAO-Assist: Edge-Deployable, Modality-Aware Agentic AI for Radiology Report Structuring
items.titleZh: MedPAO-Assist：可边缘部署、模态感知的代理 AI，用于构建放射学报告
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26913v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. To address this, we present MedPAO-Assist, an edge-deployable agentic framework that generates structured radiology reports directly from radiologist dictation and voice commands, requiring only $\approx3.3$ GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of $\approx31$ seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline. The system currently supports four major imaging modalities -- Chest X-ray, Chest CT, Abdomen CT, and Brain MRI. To our knowledge, it is among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter range. This multi-agent architecture, built around an Extract-Ground-Generate paradigm, performs concept extraction, SNOMED-CT grounding, and structured report generation, followed by a speech-driven human-in-the-loop correction phase, together forming a fully "no-touch" reporting workflow that requires no keyboard input, external API calls, or internet connectivity. We evaluate each pipeline stage individually -- concept extraction, ontology grounding, and concept categorization and report hardware profiling results demonstrating the system's feasibility for real-time, CPU-only clinical deployment.

arXiv:2610.26913v1 公告类型：新
摘要：用于放射学报告构建的大型语言模型的采用主要是基于专有云的模型或需要部署高端 GPU 的大型开放模型，这是在需要数据隐私和离线操作的放射学工作流程中临床采用的关键瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 MedPAO-Assist，这是一种可边缘部署的代理框架，可直接根据放射科医生的听写和语音命令生成结构化放射学报告，仅需要 $\approx3.3$ GB 峰值 RAM，并通过异步多线程执行管道在标准笔记本电脑 CPU 上实现 $\approx31$ 秒的平均端到端延迟。该系统目前支持四种主要成像模式——胸部X光、胸部CT、腹部CT和脑部MRI。据我们所知，它是最早使用 0.6B 参数范围内的小语言模型 (SLM) 运行整个管道的代理系统之一。这种多代理架构围绕提取-基础-生成范式构建，执行概念提取、SNOMED-CT 基础和结构化报告生成，然后是语音驱动的人机交互校正阶段，共同形成完全“非接触式”报告工作流程，无需键盘输入、外部 API 调用或互联网连接。我们单独评估每个流程阶段——概念提取、本体基础和概念分类，并报告硬件分析结果，证明系统对于实时、仅 CPU 临床部署的可行性。

items.title: DataPraxis: Scaling Analytics Tasks via Verified Workspace Evolution
items.titleZh: DataPraxis：通过验证的工作空间演进扩展分析任务
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26924v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: General-purpose agents are increasingly expected to perform professional analytics work, which requires sustained reasoning, iterative investigation, and reliable evidence. Training these capabilities requires diverse and challenging tasks. However, generating tasks directly from raw data often overlooks deeper questions that emerge through analysis and provides limited evidence for verification. To address these limitations, we introduce DataPraxis, an analytics task synthesis framework based on verified workspace evolution. The framework progressively enriches workspaces with validated findings and artifacts, then inherits and combines these workspaces to uncover deeper questions. It constructs tasks from accumulated findings and their dependencies, verifying analytical results both during evolution and after task assembly. Using this framework, we construct DataPraxis-5K, a dataset of 5,000 verified trajectories spanning diverse domains and output formats, to train DataPraxis-27B and DataPraxis-35B-A3B. DataPraxis-27B achieves 55.11 on DABStep and 51.9 on JobBench, matching or surpassing frontier models such as GLM-5.2. DataPraxis-5K is available at huggingface.co/datasets/stargazerhust/DataPraxis-5k
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26924v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人们越来越期望通用代理能够执行专业的分析工作，这需要持续的推理、迭代调查和可靠的证据。训练这些能力需要多样化且具有挑战性的任务。然而，直接从原始数据生成任务通常会忽略分析中出现的更深层次的问题，并提供有限的验证证据。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 DataPraxis，这是一个基于经过验证的工作空间演变的分析任务综合框架。该框架通过经过验证的发现和工件逐步丰富工作空间，然后继承并组合这些工作空间以发现更深层次的问题。它根据积累的发现及其依赖性构建任务，在演化过程中和任务组装后验证分析结果。使用此框架，我们构建了 DataPraxis-5K，这是一个包含 5,000 个跨越不同领域和输出格式的经过验证的轨迹的数据集，用于训练 DataPraxis-27B 和 DataPraxis-35B-A3B。 DataPraxis-27B 在 DABStep 上达到 55.11，在 JobBench 上达到 51.9，匹配或超越 GLM-5.2 等前沿模型。 DataPraxis-5K 可在 Huggingface.co/datasets/stargazerhust/DataPraxis-5k 上获取

items.title: Industrial Agentic AI: LLM-Driven New-Generation Agents for Smart Manufacturing
items.titleZh: 工业代理人工智能：法学硕士驱动的新一代智能制造代理
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26941v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are enabling agents to move beyond predefined workflows toward autonomous planning and execution, creating new opportunities for smart manufacturing. However, dynamic environments, complex physical constraints, and stringent reliability requirements hinder the direct deployment of general-purpose agents in smart manufacturing. This article presents a systematic overview of LLM-driven industrial agents. First, we analyze five key challenges and discuss the concept and core characteristics of industrial agents. We then establish a unified taxonomy covering application scenarios, embodiment forms, and five capability levels. Next, we propose a four-layer system architecture and detail its core modules and operational mechanisms for closed-loop task execution. Finally, we review representative applications across the industrial lifecycle and outline future research directions. This article provides a structured reference for the design, development, and application of industrial agents.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26941v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大语言模型（LLM）使代理能够超越预定义的工作流程，转向自主规划和执行，为智能制造创造新的机会。然而，动态环境、复杂的物理约束和严格的可靠性要求阻碍了通用智能体在智能制造中的直接部署。本文系统地概述了法学硕士驱动的工业代理。首先，我们分析了五个关键挑战，并讨论了产业代理的概念和核心特征。然后，我们建立了一个涵盖应用场景、体现形式和五个能力级别的统一分类法。接下来，我们提出了一个四层系统架构，并详细介绍了其闭环任务执行的核心模块和运行机制。最后，我们回顾了整个工业生命周期的代表性应用，并概述了未来的研究方向。本文为工业代理的设计、开发和应用提供了结构化的参考。

items.title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
items.titleZh: 修复，而不仅仅是重新采样：Lean 4 中的有界编译器引导修复
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26942v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs. But the trade is predictable: repair pays most when sampling is constrained; its return is front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing $84\text{--}96\%$ of the total gain; and the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatches. This targeted repair successfully replicates on a second benchmark (Lean Workbook), nearly doubling the solve rate with zero regressions.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26942v1 公告类型：新
摘要：自动定理证明器通常依赖于采样语言模型，但像 Lean 这样的证明助手会用精确的错误消息拒绝每个失败的步骤——纯采样会丢弃的信息。为了克服这个问题，我们引入了有界的在线步骤级修复模块。我们的搜索在每一步对 $K$ 候选策略进行采样，并最多修复 $R$ 次失败的策略。我们没有放弃失败的策略，而是将编译器的错误消息提供给预训练的修复模型，以修复单个被拒绝的步骤。这种方法提高了所有测试候选预算（$K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$）中仅采样基线的解决率，实现了高达 $32\%$ 的相对增益，并在 LeanDojo 基准的 $1{,}990$ 定理子集上解决了 $82$ 的额外定理。修复不是免费的：它用额外的运行时间来换取可到达的证明。但这种交易是可以预见的：当抽样受到限制时，维修费用最高；它的回报是预先加载的，第一次修复尝试捕获了总收益的 $84\text{--}96\%$ ；而且收益几乎完全来自浅层策略执行失败，而不是类型不匹配等结构性错误。这种有针对性的修复成功地在第二个基准（精益工作簿）上复制，在零回归的情况下，解决率几乎翻了一番。

items.title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
items.titleZh: MAMath-Bench：多模态多智能体数学推理的过程感知和鲁棒评估
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26943v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. It features fine-grained milestone annotations to evaluate systems across three dimensions: problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning-chain perturbations. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, multi-agent collaboration does not consistently improve final-answer accuracy over strong single LLMs. Second, collaboration can substantially enhance the coverage of intermediate reasoning, but such gains may come at the cost of increased reasoning redundancy. Third, current systems remain vulnerable to adversarial reasoning errors, particularly those involving subtle structural perturbations. The dataset is available at https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26943v1 公告类型：新
摘要：数学推理是大型语言模型（LLM）教育应用的一项基本能力，其中可靠的问题解决不仅需要正确的答案，还需要连贯且可验证的推理过程。通过利用多个 LLM 代理之间的协作和验证，多代理系统 (MAS) 在该领域显示出越来越大的潜力。然而，现有的评估主要关注纯文本环境中最终答案的正确性，对多模态推理能力、中间推理步骤的可靠性以及针对推理错误的鲁棒性的了解有限。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 MAMath-Bench，这是一种流程感知基准，旨在评估 MAS 的多模态数学推理能力。 MAMath-Bench 包含 1,003 个问题，涵盖 11 个数学类别、多个难度级别和多种模式，包括文本、图像和音频。它具有细粒度的里程碑注释，可以跨三个维度评估系统：问题解决的正确性、推理过程的可靠性以及对抗性推理链扰动的鲁棒性。我们的评估得出了三个主要发现。首先，与强大的单一法学硕士相比，多代理协作并不能持续提高最终答案的准确性。其次，协作可以大大增强中间推理的覆盖范围，但这种收益可能是以增加推理冗余为代价的。第三，当前的系统仍然容易受到对抗性推理错误的影响，特别是那些涉及微妙结构扰动的系统。该数据集可从 https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath 获取。
items.author: Xinping Wang, Jie Ma, Rui Xing, Wensong Guo, Xiayi Zhang, Jianhao Deng, Zihao Zhou, Boqian Yang, Feijuan He

items.title: LightCRS: Lightweight Multi-Domain Conversational Recommendation System
items.titleZh: LightCRS：轻量级多领域会话推荐系统
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26948v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Conversational recommender systems have recently adopted vision-language models to match user dialogue intents with multimodal product information. However, extending these methods to many product domains faces a dilemma: deploying a separately adapted VLM per domain scales cost linearly with the number of domains and requires routing each dialogue to the right model, while naively merging all domains into a single VLM degrades accuracy because product characteristics vary widely across categories. We propose LightCRS, a lightweight, query-conditioned framework for unified multi-domain multimodal conversational recommendation. LightCRS precomputes multimodal product representations once offline with frozen encoders. Online, a compact 5.3M-parameter module fuses this evidence for each dialogue via query-conditioned cross-attention, whose parameters are shared across all domains, and compares candidates jointly with an inter-candidate Transformer. To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct MM-R2A-25, a 25-domain benchmark pairing natural Reddit recommendation-seeking conversations with Amazon product listings. LightCRS achieves state-of-the-art average HR@1, NDCG@5, and MRR, improving HR@1 by 35.4\% over the strongest baseline while reducing per-query latency by 266 times. Joint multi-domain training itself improves HR@1 by 15.2\% over separately trained single-domain models.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26948v1 公告类型：新
摘要：会话推荐系统最近采用视觉语言模型来将用户对话意图与多模式产品信息相匹配。然而，将这些方法扩展到许多产品领域面临着一个困境：每个领域部署单独适应的 VLM 成本与领域数量成线性比例，并且需要将每个对话路由到正确的模型，而天真地将所有领域合并到单个 VLM 中会降低准确性，因为不同类别的产品特性差异很大。我们提出了 LightCRS，这是一个轻量级的、基于查询条件的框架，用于统一的多域多模式会话推荐。一旦离线，LightCRS 就会使用冻结编码器预先计算多模式产品表示。在网上，一个紧凑的 530 万参数模块通过查询条件交叉注意力融合每个对话的证据，其参数在所有域之间共享，并将候选者与候选者间 Transformer 进行联合比较。为了进行严格的评估，我们构建了 MM-R2A-25，这是一个 25 个域的基准测试，将自然的 Reddit 推荐寻求对话与亚马逊产品列表配对。 LightCRS 实现了最先进的平均 HR@1、NDCG@5 和 MRR，将 HR@1 比最强基线提高了 35.4%，同时将每次查询延迟减少了 266 倍。联合多域训练本身比单独训练的单域模型将 HR@1 提高了 15.2%。

items.title: When Planning Problems Become Hard for LLMs: Separating Structural Complexity from Semantic Interpretability
items.titleZh: 当规划问题对法学硕士来说变得困难时：将结构复杂性与语义可解释性分开
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26964v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle with classical planning, but benchmarks rarely distinguish structural difficulty from the difficulty of interpreting symbolic vocabulary. We examine seven STRIPS domains with BFS-optimal plan lengths. For predicting structural difficulty without solving an instance, the zero-training delete-relaxation heuristic $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ outperforms learned alternatives on held-out domains (mean Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$), including ridge regression ($0.707$), object count ($0.657$), and the episodic retrieval architecture ARC ($0.400$). ARC also fails to outperform a linear model using the same features. To isolate semantic effects, we progressively rename predicates while preserving states, transitions, and optimal plans. Valid LLM planning success drops from $67.5\%$ to $40.0\%$ between $0\%$ and $100\%$ renaming, while refusals remain at $0\%$. An LLM supplied with ARC's conditioning information predicts difficulty in context better than trained ARC (mean $|\rho|=0.826$). Hybrid routing between an LLM and a symbolic planner depends more on calibration to the target LLM's outcomes than on the structural score selected. Thus, established symbolic heuristics already estimate structural difficulty well; improving hybrid planning requires modeling LLM behavior sensitive to predicate semantics rather than developing more structural predictors.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26964v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）与经典规划相矛盾，但基准很少区分结构困难和解释符号词汇的困难。我们检查了七个具有 BFS 最佳计划长度的 STRIPS 域。为了在不解决实例的情况下预测结构难度，零训练删除松弛启发式 $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ 优于保留域上的学习替代方案（平均 Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$），包括岭回归（$0.707$）、对象计数（$0.657$）和情景检索架构 ARC（$0.400$）。 ARC 也未能优于使用相同特征的线性模型。为了隔离语义影响，我们逐步重命名谓词，同时保留状态、转换和最优计划。在 $0\%$ 和 $100\%$ 重命​​名之间，有效的 LLM 规划成功率从 $67.5\%$ 下降到 $40.0\%$，而拒绝率仍保持在 $0\%$。提供 ARC 调节信息的法学硕士比经过训练的 ARC 更好地预测上下文中的难度（平均值 $|\rho|=0.826$）。法学硕士和符号规划器之间的混合路由更多地取决于对目标法学硕士结果的校准，而不是所选的结构分数。因此，已建立的符号启发法已经很好地估计了结构难度。改进混合规划需要对谓词语义敏感的 LLM 行为进行建模，而不是开发更多的结构预测器。
items.author: Mayukh Debnath, Adeyinka Adedigba, Rammohan Mallipeddi

items.title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
items.titleZh: SPEM：结构感知程序记忆，可有效利用 LLM 代理的技能
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26995v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. Successful executions are written back as new Skill-DAGs, allowing procedural memory to accumulate over time. Experiments on ALFWorld and SkillsBench show that SPEM achieves the best overall effectiveness--efficiency trade-off, reaching 87.1% ALFWorld success and 38.38% SkillsBench reward while reducing token and runtime costs against strong baselines.

items.title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
items.titleZh: 多智能体协作是否可以减少临床任务中的幻觉？
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27027v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems improve performance on clinical tasks, and that improvement is often read as evidence of a more trustworthy system. However, the two are not the same claim. A clinician acts on the stated reasoning and not only on the conclusion, so whether collaboration reduces hallucination, and what decides when it does, has to be measured in the reasoning too. Yet most evaluations score only the final answer. We evaluate four systems (a single-LLM baseline and three multi-agent topologies) across four models and three clinical tasks, scoring hallucination, under a factuality and faithfulness taxonomy, inside the rationale each system generates and reporting it alongside the task metric. We report that collaboration buys task performance but not lower hallucination as a rule, and no topology is reliably better than another. The effect differs by model: of the $36$ model--system--task comparisons, $12$ are large enough to resolve --- four decreases and eight increases, with no model on both sides. What sets the level, and the direction of any change, is the model rather than the topology or the number of agents. A self-correction experiment is consistent with this: shown its own flagged errors, every model except Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct reduces hallucination; the one model for which collaboration lowers hallucination gains the most, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, the model whose hallucination it amplifies most, does not reduce its hallucination at all. We find that collaboration redistributes what its models can already do; it does not supply what they cannot.

摘要：多智能体 LLM 系统提高了临床任务的性能，这种改进通常被视为系统更值得信赖的证据。然而，两者并不是同一个说法。临床医生根据陈述的推理而不仅仅是根据结论采取行动，因此合作是否会减少幻觉，以及什么时候会减少幻觉，也必须在推理中进行衡量。然而大多数评估只给出最终答案。我们评估了四个系统（一个单一法学硕士基线和三个多代理拓扑），涵盖四个模型和三个临床任务，根据事实和忠实性分类法，在每个系统生成的基本原理内对幻觉进行评分，并与任务指标一起报告。我们报告说，协作可以提高任务性能，但通常不能降低幻觉，而且没有一种拓扑确实比另一种更好。效果因模型而异：在 36 美元的模型-系统-任务比较中，12 美元足够大，可以解决——四次减少和八次增加，双方都没有模型。决定任何变化的级别和方向的是模型，而不是拓扑或代理数量。自校正实验与此一致：显示了自己标记的错误，除了 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 之外的每个模型都减少了幻觉；协作降低幻觉效果最大的模型，而 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 模型（其幻觉放大程度最高）根本没有减少其幻觉。我们发现协作重新分配了其模型已经可以做的事情；它不提供他们不能提供的东西。

items.title: Teaching AI Agent to Play Poker Strategically Through Preference Optimization
items.titleZh: 通过偏好优化教 AI 智能体有策略地玩扑克
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27028v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: A poker agent can make a legal move and still make a strategically poor one. We ask whether compact AI agents can exhibit strategic behavior under hidden information and whether preference optimization can improve beyond static and zero-shot policies. We first evaluate a static baseline and three frozen language models: SmallThinker, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 whose performance varies substantially between exact-game and six-player evaluation. We therefore propose Strategic Preference Optimization with KL-anchored Equilibrium (SPOKE), combining teacher-relative value penalties, policy anchoring, risk constraints, and structured rationale supervision, and compare it with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and GSPO. Across three runs of a SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B policy, SPOKE achieves the lowest mean exploitability in Kuhn (0.213) and Leduc (1.081) and the highest six-max top-1 agreement (0.775), while maintaining teacher KL comparable to SFT (0.522 vs 0.523). These results provide preliminary evidence that strategic preference optimization can improve strategic quality while preserving teacher-consistent behavior.

arXiv:2610.27028v1 公告类型：新
摘要：扑克代理人可以采取合法的行动，但仍然会做出战略上不佳的行动。我们询问紧凑型人工智能代理是否可以在隐藏信息下表现出策略行为，以及偏好优化是否可以超越静态和零样本策略。我们首先评估静态基线和三个冻结语言模型：SmallThinker、Qwen3 和 Gemma-3，其性能在精确游戏评估和六人评估之间差异很大。因此，我们提出了KL锚定均衡策略偏好优化（SPOKE），结合教师相对价值惩罚、政策锚定、风险约束和结构化理由监督，并将其与SFT、DPO、GRPO和GSPO进行比较。在 SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B 策略的三轮运行中，SPOKE 在 Kuhn (0.213) 和 Leduc (1.081) 中实现了最低的平均可利用性，以及最高的 6-max top-1 协议 (0.775)，同时保持教师 KL 与 SFT 相当（0.522 vs 0.523）。这些结果提供了初步证据，表明战略偏好优化可以提高战略质量，同时保持教师一致的行为。

items.title: M-Plan: Comprehensive Planning For LLM Agents with Memory Arrangement
items.titleZh: M-Plan：LLM代理的全面规划与内存安排
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27032v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated outstanding performance in single-turn tasks, yet they continue to struggle with long-horizon tasks, particularly in environments without prior training. A key limitation of single LLMs is their difficulty in processing long contexts, which stems from weaknesses in continuous decision-making and reasoning capabilities. Although existing multi-agent systems (MAS) equipped with long-term memory bases can partially address this gap, they mostly rely on knowledge reuse or summarization, an approach that is often constrained by directly retrieval without any adaptation for the current task, while the retrieved memory may contain much history noises waiting to be preprocessed. In contrast, MAS characterized by task-specific guidance often lack long-term memory specifically designed for the guidance. To address these challenges, we propose M-Plan, a closed-loop MAS framework that integrates long-term and short-term memory. By combining global-local and past-current guidance, M-Plan enhances agents' performance on multi-turn tasks while maintaining a plug-and-play design. During task execution, agents receive task-specific milestones and insights, and are provided with local hints only when confusion arises, which form global-local guidance together. These guidance generation and utilization construct the short-term memory as well. After task completion, relevant information about the current task is optimized or reorganized before being sent to the long-term memory storage for future retrieval. The designments mentioned above build a comprehensive framework different from other individual long-term or short-term memory works. Extensive experiments on multi-turn tasks including ALFWorld, Webshop, and PDDL across diverse models demonstrate that M-Plan outperforms multiple baseline methods in both accuracy and efficiency.

摘要：基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体最近在单轮任务中表现出了出色的性能，但它们在长期任务中仍然表现不佳，特别是在没有事先训练的环境中。单一法学硕士的一个关键限制是它们难以处理长上下文，这源于持续决策和推理能力的弱点。尽管现有的配备长期记忆库的多智能体系统（MAS）可以部分解决这一差距，但它们主要依赖于知识重用或总结，这种方法通常受到直接检索的限制，而没有对当前任务进行任何适应，而检索到的记忆可能包含大量等待预处理的历史噪声。相比之下，以任务特定指导为特征的 MAS 往往缺乏专门为指导设计的长期记忆。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 M-Plan，这是一个集成了长期和短期记忆的闭环 MAS 框架。通过结合全局-本地和过去-当前的指导，M-Plan 增强了代理在多轮任务上的性能，同时保持了即插即用的设计。在任务执行过程中，代理会收到特定于任务的里程碑和见解，并且仅在出现混乱时才提供本地提示，从而共同形成全局-本地指导。这些指导的生成和利用也构建了短期记忆。任务完成后，当前任务的相关信息会被优化或重组，然后发送到长期记忆存储以供将来检索。上述设计构建了一个不同于其他单独的长期或短期记忆工作的综合框架。对多轮任务（包括 ALFWorld、Webshop 和 PDDL）跨不同模型的广泛实验表明，M-Plan 在准确性和效率方面均优于多个基线方法。

items.title: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
items.titleZh: 物理人工智能：概念、技术和挑战
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27045v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).

items.title: High-dimensional layer-state trajectories reveal the internal dynamics of transformer inference
items.titleZh: 高维层态轨迹揭示了变压器推理的内部动态
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26866v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Mechanistic studies of large language models localize function in parameters, attention heads or neurons, but those parts do not specify how one inference unfolds. We treat the ordered layer-state trajectory as the empirical process and test whether layer order defines a measurable computation. Across representative Qwen, Llama and Gemma checkpoints, realized order produced paths 1.60--2.24 times as aligned with their endpoint chord as endpoint-preserving shuffles. The order effect transferred to a lexical task, but was stronger in three random initializations of the same Qwen architecture, identifying an architecture-compatible scaffold rather than a training-specific law. Direct hidden states provided stronger mechanism coordinates than vocabulary readbacks, and a task-defined coordinate made candidate competition computable. After additive interventions failed, local transition actuators selectively controlled internal trajectories across checkpoints. A confidence gate then drove 17 of 87 held-out Qwen closure trajectories across the full-vocabulary top-1 candidate boundary while leaving all 203 non-closure top-1 outputs unchanged. Safety-matched action reassignment performed similarly, locating the gain in selective gating and the bounded actuator family rather than fine-grained dose assignment. Layer order exposes an observable, computable and behaviourally consequential process of transformer inference without establishing a complete theory of LLM dynamics or control of answer correctness.

items.title: Steerable Pluralistic Policy Alignment from Anonymized Crowd Feedback
items.titleZh: 来自匿名人群反馈的可引导多元政策调整
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26914v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Pluralistic alignment requires AI systems to learn from diverse populations whose preferences may reflect heterogeneous or even conflicting objectives, and to personalize their behavior to individual users. Existing approaches in pluralistic alignment often assume access to annotator identities and rely on powerful pretrained representations to model individual preference variations. We propose Preference-PCA Pluralistic Learning (P3L), a novel framework for pluralistic alignment that jointly learns trajectory embeddings and the shared basis of preference directions via PCA decomposition from heterogeneous crowd feedback without requiring annotator identities. At test time, our approach enables rapid and accurate personalized reward learning and downstream policy optimization. Experiments across multiple embodied control tasks demonstrate that P3L enables steerable personal alignment that generalizes beyond the offline dataset to out-of-distribution new users and attains competitive RL and test performance, while substantially reducing computational cost and supporting variable adaptation query budgets.

items.title: Expert-Guided Rubrics as Dense Reward Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Non-Verifiable Domains
items.titleZh: 专家指导的评分标准作为不可​​验证领域强化学习的密集奖励信号
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26932v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in non-verifiable domains such as financial services, where they must interpret user intent, rewrite queries, and retrieve information under domain-specific constraints. Although reinforcement learning (RL) can train such agents from the consequences of their actions, recent successes largely rely on verifiable tasks with automatically computed binary rewards. In non-verifiable retrieval tasks, assessing query quality requires scarce subject-matter expert (SME) judgment that is inherently graded rather than binary. With Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), sparse rewards yield no useful learning signal when all sampled outputs within a group receive the same outcome, causing optimization to stall. We introduce a method that converts a small, fixed investment of SME judgment into a dense reward and combines it with retrieval-based metrics to form a hybrid, GRPO-compatible training signal. Experiments show improvements of up to 6\% in Recall@3 and 6.7\% in MRR@3 compared with sparse-reward baselines.

摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地作为自治代理部署在金融服务等不可验证的领域，它们必须解释用户意图、重写查询并在特定领域的约束下检索信息。尽管强化学习（RL）可以根据其行为的后果来训练此类智能体，但最近的成功很大程度上依赖于具有自动计算的二元奖励的可验证任务。在不可验证的检索任务中，评估查询质量需要稀缺的主题专家 (SME) 判断，这种判断本质上是分级的，而不是二进制的。使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）时，当组内的所有采样输出都收到相同的结果时，稀疏奖励不会产生有用的学习信号，从而导致优化停滞。我们引入了一种方法，将 SME 判断的小额固定投资转换为密集奖励，并将其与基于检索的指标相结合，形成混合的、与 GRPO 兼容的训练信号。实验表明，与稀疏奖励基线相比，Recall@3 的改进高达 6%，MRR@3 的改进高达 6.7%。

items.title: Beyond Policy Discrepancy: Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.titleZh: 超越政策差异：能力意识多教师的政策蒸馏
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26950v2 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates domain specialists into a shared student, but determining how strongly each teacher should supervise remains challenging. Existing discrepancy-based allocation can assign strong supervision even when the student already matches or exceeds the teacher's task performance, since behavioral mismatch does not necessarily imply a remaining capability deficit. We propose Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (CA-MOPD), which combines specialist merging with capability-guided allocation to account for what the student has already learned. CA-MOPD first merges reinforcement-learning specialists into a strong student initialization, then uses verifier-estimated teacher--student capability gaps to adjust domain-level distillation strength. Supervision decreases as capability gaps close and increases when estimated student capability regresses, while dense token-level guidance remains provided by the teachers. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and instruction following, CA-MOPD achieves an average score of 32.22, outperforming naive MOPD, Open-MOPD, and the merged initialization by 0.86, 0.83, and 0.74 points, respectively. Controlled comparisons further support the benefits of merged initialization and capability-gap guidance under matched training budgets.

arXiv:2610.26950v2 公告类型：新
摘要：多教师策略蒸馏（MOPD）将领域专家整合到共享学生中，但确定每个教师应监督的力度仍然具有挑战性。即使学生已经匹配或超过教师的任务表现，现有的基于差异的分配也可以分配强有力的监督，因为行为不匹配并不一定意味着剩余的能力缺陷。我们提出能力感知多教师按策略蒸馏（CA-MOPD），它将专家合并与能力引导分配相结合，以考虑学生已经学到的知识。 CA-MOPD 首先将强化学习专家合并到强大的学生初始化中，然后使用验证者估计的师生能力差距来调整领域级蒸馏强度。当能力差距缩小时，监督就会减少；而当估计的学生能力下降时，监督就会增加，而教师仍然提供密集的象征性指导。在涵盖数学、代码生成和指令跟踪的六个基准测试中，CA-MOPD 的平均得分为 32.22，分别比 naive MOPD、Open-MOPD 和合并初始化高出 0.86、0.83 和 0.74 分。受控比较进一步支持了在匹配的培训预算下合并初始化和能力差距指导的好处。

items.title: Dynamic System Inspired Continuous Large Language Model for AI4Science Tasks
items.titleZh: 动态系统启发了 AI4Science 任务的连续大型语言模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26959v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Scientific foundation models increasingly operate on continuous phenomena, yet still use discrete residual computation. We ask whether pretrained residual transformations can support additional latent computation without expanding the backbone. To test this possibility, we introduce Continuum-LM, which reuses these transformations as dynamical operators in a continuous-depth language model. Its hidden states evolve through an ordinary differential equation evaluated by higher-order numerical integration, with solver order and step size controlling computation. Across eight scientific tasks, Continuum-LM trains stably and improves mean exact-match accuracy by 7.77 and 10.96 percentage points over discrete counterparts at the 0.6B and 1.7B scales, respectively. At 0.6B, it also outperforms an Ouro-style recurrent control under matched parameter and residual-function evaluation budgets. Together, these results support extensible computational depth through parameter reuse, identifying continuous hidden-state evolution as a practical design dimension for scientific language models beyond parameter scaling.

arXiv:2610.26959v1 公告类型：新
摘要：科学基础模型越来越多地对连续现象进行操作，但仍然使用离散残差计算。我们询问预训练的残差变换是否可以在不扩展主干网络的情况下支持额外的潜在计算。为了测试这种可能性，我们引入了 Continuum-LM，它将这些转换重用为连续深度语言模型中的动态运算符。其隐藏状态通过由高阶数值积分评估的常微分方程演化，并通过求解器阶数和步长控制计算。在 8 项科学任务中，Continuum-LM 能够稳定训练，并且在 0.6B 和 1.7B 尺度上，平均精确匹配精度比离散对应模型分别提高 7.77 和 10.96 个百分点。在 0.6B 时，它在匹配参数和残差函数评估预算下也优于 Ouro 式循环控制。总之，这些结果通过参数重用支持可扩展的计算深度，将连续隐藏状态演化识别为参数缩放之外的科学语言模型的实用设计维度。
items.author: Zhaoxin Fan, Zheng Zhu, Yuqing Ma, Faguo Wu, Jian Yang, Wenjun Wu

items.title: Transformers Learn Two Competing Sorting Algorithms, and Only One Length-Generalizes
items.titleZh: Transformers 学习两种相互竞争的排序算法，并且只学习一种长度泛化算法
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26974v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We show that two-layer transformers trained to near-zero loss on a sorting task converge to one of two mechanistically distinct solution classes depending on their initialization. One solution class consists of solutions that do not use the second attention layer to sort, but also fail to length-generalize. The other, which uses both attention layers, length-generalizes perfectly, despite only being trained to sort sequences of a fixed length. By carefully choosing the weight initialization, we demonstrate that we can steer the model toward learning one solution or the other. We identify input types that are rare at the training length but increasingly common at longer sequence lengths as a source of this disparity in length-generalization, and find that layer-wise specialization of the second class of solutions allows them to handle these rare sequences more accurately. In the second class, we discover a mechanism by which the second layer attention can use the contextual information gathered by the first layer attention to reduce its search space. On the related task of finding the minimum of a sequence, we find a similar two solution-type phenomenon, but with the opposite generalization pattern, where a different form of layer-wise specialization causes the two-layer solution to length-generalize worse than the single-attention solution.

arXiv:2610.26974v1 公告类型：新
摘要：我们表明，在排序任务中训练到接近零损失的两层变压器根据其初始化收敛到两个机械上不同的解决方案类别之一。一类解决方案由不使用第二个注意力层进行排序但也无法进行长度泛化的解决方案组成。另一个使用两个注意力层，尽管只被训练来对固定长度的序列进行排序，但长度概括却很完美。通过仔细选择权重初始化，我们证明我们可以引导模型学习一种解决方案或另一种解决方案。我们将在训练长度上罕见但在较长序列长度上越来越常见的输入类型确定为长度泛化差异的根源，并发现第二类解决方案的逐层专业化使它们能够更准确地处理这些罕见序列。在第二类中，我们发现了一种机制，第二层注意力可以使用第一层注意力收集的上下文信息来减少其搜索空间。在寻找序列最小值的相关任务中，我们发现了类似的两解决方案类型现象，但具有相反的泛化模式，其中不同形式的逐层专门化导致两层解决方案的长度泛化能力比单注意力解决方案更差。
items.author: Khashayar Gatmiry, Nathan W. Henry, Chloe H. Su, Emmanuel Abbe, Samy Bengio, Melanie Weber, Jonathan A. Kelner, Peter L. Bartlett

items.title: Latent Projection for Latent Planning
items.titleZh: 潜在规划的潜在预测
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26979v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.

arXiv:2610.26979v1 公告类型：新
摘要：潜在世界模型让智能体在潜在空间中进行规划。规划器搜索使成本最小化的动作序列，该成本通常是预测的终端潜伏和目标潜伏之间的 $\ell_2$ 距离。然而，潜在的部分是噪音：在世界模型训练期间防止崩溃的正则化器会促进不携带信号的方向上的方差。我们表明，相同的正则化器还提供了修剪潜在噪声的结构。 SIGReg 在每一步将潜在边际驱动为标准高斯，并进一步假设潜在序列是高斯-马尔可夫过程，转换与其由映射本身固定的协方差呈线性关系，$z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$。因此，拟合状态动态 $A$ 无需额外成本即可产生协方差，并且在其特征基中，每个潜在方向都具有其自身的不确定性。此外，将 $A$ 限制为正常矩阵可以修复跨时间步长的基础，因此一个特征基可以衡量任意数量步长上的不确定性，并作为计算规划成本的稳定基础。然后，我们将 $\ell_2$ 成本限制在状态动态以最小不确定性进行的 $k$ 维子空间。修正是事后进行的：编码器、预测器、rollout 和规划器都保持不变，只有一个约束矩阵 $A$ 适合。我们对六种环境进行了评估，并显示 2D 导航任务、TwoRoom 和 PointMaze 取得了巨大的进步，在更严格的规划设置下，与简单的 $\ell_2$ 成本相比，成功率提高了高达 $+54.7$ 点。代码可在 https://github.com/yjang43/lp2 获取。

items.title: CoASFL: Coupled Consistency Optimization for Asynchronous Split Federated Learning
items.titleZh: CoASFL：异步分裂联邦学习的耦合一致性优化
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26992v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Split Federated Learning (SFL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training large-scale deep models on resource-constrained edge devices. Although asynchronous SFL alleviates the straggler bottleneck caused by system heterogeneity, it inevitably introduces two coupled dimensions of inconsistency: horizontal inconsistency across clients and vertical inconsistency between clients and the server. These inconsistencies, further exacerbated by statistical heterogeneity, result in biased activation representations, model divergence, and severe client drift. To address these challenges, we propose CoASFL, an inconsistency-aware asynchronous SFL framework that incorporates a dynamic activation merging mechanism and a consistency-aware model aggregation mechanism. Specifically, CoASFL constructs more consistent activation sequences from heterogeneous clients to alleviate horizontal inconsistency, and dynamically adjusts aggregation weights according to client participation frequencies and progress gaps to mitigate vertical inconsistency. By jointly coordinating activation-level and model-level consistency, CoASFL effectively suppresses inconsistency propagation during asynchronous training. Extensive experiments on an 80-device heterogeneous edge testbed demonstrate that CoASFL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SFL approaches, accelerating training by 1.61$\times$ to 3.74$\times$ and improving final model accuracy by up to 3.26\% under heterogeneous scenarios.

arXiv:2610.26992v1 公告类型：新
摘要：分割联邦学习（SFL）已成为在资源受限的边缘设备上训练大规模深度模型的有前途的范例。虽然异步SFL缓解了系统异构性造成的落后瓶颈，但它不可避免地引入了两个耦合的不一致维度：客户端之间的水平不一致以及客户端和服务器之间的垂直不一致。统计异质性进一步加剧了这些不一致，导致激活表示有偏差、模型分歧和严重的客户端漂移。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 CoASFL，一种不一致感知异步 SFL 框架，它结合了动态激活合并机制和一致性感知模型聚合机制。具体来说，CoASFL从异构客户端构造更一致的激活序列以减轻水平不一致，并根据客户端参与频率和进度差距动态调整聚合权重以减轻垂直不一致。通过共同协调激活级别和模型级别的一致性，CoASFL 有效地抑制了异步训练期间的不一致性传播。在 80 台设备异构边缘测试台上进行的大量实验表明，CoASFL 始终优于最先进的 SFL 方法，将训练速度加快 1.61$\times$ 至 3.74$\times$，并将异构场景下的最终模型精度提高高达 3.26\%。
items.author: Junhao Cheng, Yunming Liao, Hongli Xu, Yang Xu, Zuan Xie

items.title: CorteXforge: Scenario-Based RF Dataset Generation on Real Testbeds
items.titleZh: CorteXforge：在真实测试台上生成基于场景的射频数据集
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26999v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Deep learning for radio frequency (RF) signal analysis relies on large annotated datasets, yet synthetic datasets trade physical realism for controllability, while uncontrolled over-theair measurements offer realism but limited reproducibility. We present CorteXforge, a scenario-based framework for generating realistic and reproducible RF datasets on programmable software defined radio (SDR) testbeds. High-level RF scenarios are automatically translated into synchronized experiments executed on the SLICES-RI/CorteXlab platform, producing fully annotated Signal Metadata Format (SIGMF) datasets that capture hardware impairments and propagation effects. We validate CorteXforge through automatic modulation classification using ModForge, an over-the-air (OTA) dataset generated with the framework. Cross-domain experiments reveal a synthetic-to-real performance gap and show that synthetic pretraining remains beneficial for adaptation to OTA data. CorteXforge provides a practical foundation for reproducible RF dataset generation and future research on domain generalization.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26999v1 公告类型：新
摘要：射频 (RF) 信号分析的深度学习依赖于大型注释数据集，但合成数据集以物理真实性换取可控性，而不受控制的无线测量提供真实性，但再现性有限。我们推出了 CorteXforge，这是一个基于场景的框架，用于在可编程软件定义无线电 (SDR) 测试台上生成真实且可重复的射频数据集。高级 RF 场景会自动转换为在 SLICES-RI/CorteXlab 平台上执行的同步实验，生成完全注释的信号元数据格式 (SIGMF) 数据集，用于捕获硬件损伤和传播效应。我们使用 ModForge（由该框架生成的无线 (OTA) 数据集）通过自动调制分类来验证 CorteXforge。跨域实验揭示了合成与真实性能之间的差距，并表明合成预训练仍然有利于适应 OTA 数据。 CorteXforge 为可重复的 RF 数据集生成和未来领域泛化研究提供了实用基础。
items.author: Andr\'ea Joly (CITI), Leonardo S Cardoso (CITI), Jean-Marie Gorce

items.title: ORBIT: Autoregressive Time Series Generation via Next Frequency-Band Prediction
items.titleZh: ORBIT：通过下一个频段预测生成自回归时间序列
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27000v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Deep generative models provide an effective modern solution to alleviating the problem of data scarcity by synthesizing realistic time series. However, despite the considerable progress achieved by existing deep time series generators, two key challenges remain: (1) learning hierarchical representations for heterogeneous temporal patterns; and (2) coordinating the generation process of heterogeneous temporal dynamics. To address these key bottlenecks, in this work, we propose ORBIT, a unified deep generative framework for time series. Specifically, we develop two key components: the Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) and the Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer (FBAR). The former learns hierarchical representations by decomposing latent temporal representations into different frequency bands and applying residual quantization with increasing token budgets. The latter establishes a novel low-to-high frequency autoregressive direction, yielding a time series generation process that first constructs global temporal structures and then incrementally incorporates fine-grained temporal details. These compact designs not only disentangle heterogeneous temporal patterns for more effective representation learning but also mitigate potential interference among different temporal dynamics during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that ORBIT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance while exhibiting superior inference efficiency compared with advanced baselines.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.27000v1 公告类型：新
摘要：深度生成模型通过合成现实时间序列，为缓解数据稀缺问题提供了有效的现代解决方案。然而，尽管现有的深度时间序列生成器取得了相当大的进步，但仍然存在两个关键挑战：（1）学习异构时间模式的层次表示； (2)协调异质时间动态的生成过程。为了解决这些关键瓶颈，在这项工作中，我们提出了 ORBIT，一个统一的时间序列深度生成框架。具体来说，我们开发了两个关键组件：频率分层 VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) 和频段自回归变压器 (FBAR)。前者通过将潜在时间表示分解为不同的频带并通过增加令牌预算应用残差量化来学习分层表示。后者建立了一种新颖的从低频到高频的自回归方向，产生一个时间序列生成过程，该过程首先构建全局时间结构，然后逐步合并细粒度的时间细节。这些紧凑的设计不仅可以解开异构时间模式以实现更有效的表示学习，而且还可以减轻生成过程中不同时间动态之间的潜在干扰。对多个具有挑战性的现实世界基准进行的大量实验表明，ORBIT 实现了最先进的整体性能，同时与先进基准相比表现出卓越的推理效率。
items.author: Chunyi Hou, Xiangfei Qiu, Hanyin Cheng, Chenchen Sun, Yisheng An, Yang Shu, Jilin Hu, Bin Yang

items.title: HierDTA: Hierarchical Structure-Aware Representation Learning for Drug--Target Affinity Prediction
items.titleZh: HierDTA：药物靶点亲和力预测的层次结构感知表示学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27001v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Drug--target affinity (DTA) prediction plays an important role in computer-aided drug discovery, where reliable computational models can help prioritize compound--protein pairs before experimental validation. A key challenge in DTA prediction is to effectively mine multi-level molecular information from drug structures while accurately modeling the binding-site environment of target proteins. To address these issues, we introduce HierDTA, a hierarchical structure-aware framework for DTA prediction. \textcolor{black}{HierDTA represents each drug as an atom--motif heterogeneous graph and introduces an augmentation module that propagates functional-motif semantics to the corresponding atoms. For proteins, kinase-domain structures are converted into residue interaction graphs. The resulting atom and residue representations are integrated using cross-attention to capture pair-specific relationships, while molecule fingerprints and pretrained ESM-2 embeddings provide complementary global information. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, HierDTA achieves superior performance on the Davis dataset across all metrics and attains the highest \(r_m^2\) of 0.791 on KIBA. It also exhibits strong generalization under cold-start settings, particularly on KIBA, where MSE is reduced by 21.7\% in the unseen-protein scenario. Ablation study and interpretability analysis supported the contributions of the hierarchical augmentation and interaction components.} Case studies further showed that HierDTA provided early enrichment of candidate bioactive compounds. These results indicate that HierDTA is an effective framework for affinity prediction and target-specific virtual screening.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.27001v1 公告类型：新
摘要：药物-靶点亲和力（DTA）预测在计算机辅助药物发现中发挥着重要作用，其中可靠的计算模型可以帮助在实验验证之前优先考虑化合物-蛋白质对。 DTA 预测的一个关键挑战是有效地从药物结构中挖掘多层次的分子信息，同时准确地模拟靶蛋白的结合位点环境。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了 HierDTA，一种用于 DTA 预测的分层结构感知框架。 \textcolor{black}{HierDTA 将每种药物表示为原子基序异质图，并引入了将功能基序语义传播到相应原子的增强模块。对于蛋白质，激酶结构域结构被转换为残基相互作用图。使用交叉注意力来集成生成的原子和残基表示，以捕获特定对的关系，而分子指纹和预训练的 ESM-2 嵌入则提供互补的全局信息。与最先进的方法相比，HierDTA 在 Davis 数据集上的所有指标上都实现了卓越的性能，并在 KIBA 上获得了最高的 \(r_m^2\) 0.791。它还在冷启动设置下表现出很强的泛化能力，特别是在 KIBA 上，在看不见的蛋白质场景中，MSE 降低了 21.7%。消融研究和可解释性分析支持了分层增强和相互作用成分的贡献。}案例研究进一步表明，HierDTA 提供了候选生物活性化合物的早期富集。这些结果表明 HierDTA 是亲和力预测和目标特异性虚拟筛选的有效框架。
items.author: Huangchao Xu, Baohua Zhang, Qian Liu, Zhong Jin, Yi Du

items.title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.titleZh: 通过激活空间引导进行探索，以实现具有可验证奖励的强化学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27012v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.27012v1 公告类型：新
摘要：具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过对响应进行采样、使用自动验证器对其进行评分并根据所得奖励更新策略来训练语言模型。因此，该政策仅从其推出时出现的轨迹接收直接学习信号。然而，对同一政策的重复抽样可能会集中在类似的推理路径上，从而在固定的推出预算下留下未探索的有用替代方案。我们引入激活空间探索（ASE），这是一种用于多样化训练推出的在线方法。通过对同一问题的正确和错误响应之间的激活差异进行聚类，ASE 构建了潜在探索向量的结构化库。然后将不同的向量应用于后续的推出，以探索替代的推理路径。在 DAPO-Math-17k 上训练的 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，在相同的部署预算下，ASE 在六个数学推理基准上的平均 Mean@8 比 GRPO 分别提高了 4.87 和 1.87 个百分点。
items.author: Yunan Zeng, Jinhao Jing, Xi Cheng, Yuwang Wang

items.title: EGiME: Entropy-Guided Model Evaluation in Few-Shot Learning
items.titleZh: EGiME：小样本学习中的熵引导模型评估
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27029v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The feature-extraction quality of pre-trained models sets the ceiling of downstream transfer learning, yet few-shot model selection remains difficult: supervised evaluation on scarce labels is unstable and yields fluctuating rankings. We propose Entropy-Guided Model Evaluation (EGiME), a semi-supervised criterion that assesses a candidate model from the clustering structure of its feature space without any classifier training. EGiME performs $K$-means clustering over all labeled and unlabeled samples, then combines two entropy terms: an inter-cluster entropy measuring global separability, and an intra-cluster entropy measuring the compactness of labeled anchors, fused through an inverse-frequency weight that emphasizes small clusters. On five few-shot benchmarks and nine pre-trained models, EGiME achieves a correlation score of 0.966 with the full-pool ground-truth accuracy obtained by averaging the accuracies of K-means, KNN, and SVM. At labeling ratios of 4\%--20\%, it produces markedly more stable model rankings than cross-validated supervised baselines, establishing it as a practical alternative to conventional supervised evaluation for pre-trained model selection under data scarcity.

items.title: Hilbert-Scale Stability of Posterior Diffusion Priors for Ill-Posed Signal Recovery
items.titleZh: 不适定信号恢复的后扩散先验的希尔伯特尺度稳定性
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27030v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Indirect and noisy observations are difficult to invert when the forward operator smooths out the unknown signal. In this case, the unstable modes are precisely the modes that the data reveals least, thus the success of any reconstruction method depends on how prior information interacts with the geometry of the operator across regularity scales. Diffusion priors have become ubiquitous for such problems; however, the current theory still does not determine when a learned score remains informative under ill-posed forward operators. In this paper, we study posterior diffusion for linear inverse problems on Hilbert scales and derive a stability theory under an explicit score-amplification condition. Under a smoothing condition on the forward map, a source condition on the truth, and weak-norm control of score error, we derive non-asymptotic recovery bounds in \(\Hs^s\) that separate observation noise, score approximation, and reverse-time discretization. These bounds give a recoverable regularity threshold determined jointly by operator smoothing, truth regularity, score regularity, and the posterior correction. The threshold specifies the Hilbert-scale norms \(\Hs^s\) in which weak-norm score error remains controlled after propagation through the posterior reverse dynamics. For larger regularity indices \(s\), the inverse geometry magnifies the same error, and the Hilbert-scale recovery estimate no longer gives uniform stability. We also prove that a posterior correction adapted to the forward operator improves stability relative to isotropic guidance in the regularity ranges where the smoothing action of the forward map matters most. The recovery estimates give a regularity-sensitive theory of posterior diffusion and show how learned score error, operator smoothing, and reconstruction norm jointly determine the stable range predicted by the analysis.

摘要：当前向算子平滑未知信号时，间接观测和噪声观测很难反转。在这种情况下，不稳定模式恰恰是数据揭示最少的模式，因此任何重建方法的成功取决于先验信息如何与算子的几何形状在正则性尺度上相互作用。对于此类问题，扩散先验已经变得无处不在。然而，当前的理论仍然无法确定学习分数在不适定前向算子下何时仍能提供信息。在本文中，我们研究了希尔伯特量表上线性逆问题的后向扩散，并推导了显式分数放大条件下的稳定性理论。在前向图的平滑条件、真实值的源条件和分数误差的弱范数控制下，我们推导了 \(\Hs^s\) 中的非渐近恢复界限，将观测噪声、分数近似和逆时离散化分开。这些界限给出了由算子平滑、真值规律性、得分规律性和后验校正共同确定的可恢复规律性阈值。该阈值指定希尔伯特尺度范数 \(\Hs^s\)，其中弱范数得分误差在通过后验反向动力学传播后仍然受到控制。对于较大的规律性指数 \(s\)，逆几何放大了相同的误差，并且希尔伯特尺度恢复估计不再给出均匀稳定性。我们还证明，适应前向算子的后验校正提高了在前向地图的平滑作用最重要的规则范围内相对于各向同性引导的稳定性。恢复估计给出了后扩散的规律性敏感理论，并显示了学习得分误差、算子平滑和重建范数如何共同确定分析预测的稳定范围。

items.title: LEAF: LUT-aware Efficient Attention on FPGAs
items.titleZh: LEAF：FPGA 上的 LUT 感知高效关注
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27078v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We introduce Lookup-table (LUT)-aware Efficient Attention on FPGAs (LEAF). LEAF is the first nanosecond-scale LUT-aware transformer for FPGAs. Deploying transformers that are large enough to perform well, small enough to fit on an FPGA, and fast enough to meet the sub-microsecond timescales required by real-time systems such as those at CERN remains difficult, since the same attention mechanism that gives these models their high expressivity also makes them costly to implement in hardware. LEAF converts the query, key, and value projections and the final output feed-forward layer into FPGA-native layers with LUT-aware training, creating the first LUT-aware transformer and linformer layers built for ultra-low-latency inference. Attention resists LUT-aware training because it multiplies two activations where the method needs a constant weight to tabulate; LEAF tabulates the attention block's constant matrix-vector multiplications and leaves the rest in arithmetic form. On a standard jet tagging benchmark this improves accuracy by 1.8 percentage points while using 2.9 times fewer LUTs than the previous state-of-the-art sub-microsecond transformer at the same input size. Our most efficient LEAF-based linformer with 64 input particles reaches 80.4% classification accuracy at 28k LUTs and 35ns.
